name: Fetch email logs
description: Call this when you need to retrieve a paginated list of transactional email logs for a specific date range. Use a GET‑based logs endpoint (if available) instead when you only need to read logs without submitting a request body.

startDate.description: ISO‑8601 start of the time window for which logs should be returned.

endDate.description: ISO‑8601 end of the time window for which logs should be returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return per page.

data.description: Array of email log objects; null if no logs match the query.

limit.description: The limit that was applied to the query.

skip.description: Number of records skipped (offset) based on pagination.

totalCount.description: Total number of log entries matching the query.
